title: Business Development Executive (BDE)- Robotics/ Oil & Gas
jobDescription:
Job Title: Business Development Executive (BDE) – Robotics/Oil & Gas
Company: PetroBot Technologies Private Limited
Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan (On-site)
Experience: 1–3 Years (Technical B2B Sales / NDT / Oil & Gas preferred)
Education: B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering (Electronics/Electrical also considered) or equivalent field experience.
Joining: Immediate Joiners Only (Max 15 days notice period)

What You Will Do (Responsibilities):

  • Lead Generation: Find new B2B leads using the GeM Portal, LinkedIn, and cold outreach.
  • Sales Execution: Conduct cold calls, send pitches, and introduce our robotic solutions to industrial clients.
  • Client Coordination: Act as the first point of contact, schedule technical demos, and maintain the CRM.
  • Tender Support: Help the team compile data for quotations, bids, and government tender documents.
  • Market Tracking: Monitor competitor activities and track industry shifts.
minimumQualification:
What We Are Looking For (Requirements):

  • Education: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering is highly preferred. Candidates with strong, relevant field experience in NDT/Oil & Gas sales without a degree are also welcome.
  • Experience: 1–3 years in B2B technical sales, industrial services, or engineering sales.
  • Skills: Strong cold-calling skills, excellent English & Hindi communication, and a target-driven mindset.
  • Availability: Must be able to join immediately or within 2 weeks.
preferredQualification:
Candidate Profile

  • Growth Mindset: Interested in long-term employment with a desire to move up within the company.
  • Work Ethic: Willing to work at any level and "get your hands dirty" to ensure project success.
  • Adaptability: Able to handle the pressure of live site environments and remote location.

title: Electronics & Electrical Engineer – Robotics (Oil & Gas Asset Integrity)
jobDescription:
Job Title

Electronics & Electrical Engineer – Robotics (Oil & Gas Asset Integrity)

Key Responsibilities

  • Robotic Development: Design, develop, and integrate electronic systems, sensors, and power systems into robotic crawlers and inspection platforms.
  • Electronics Troubleshooting: Perform diagnostics, circuit troubleshooting, and maintenance of existing inspection robots.
  • Field Deployment: Support field deployment, on-site commissioning, and operation of robotic NDT equipment at refineries, offshore platforms, and tank farms.
  • Sensor Calibration: Work closely with NDT technicians to calibrate ultrasonic, acoustic, and visual sensors to accurately detect flaws and corrosion.
  • Safety & Compliance: Ensure all electronic and electrical designs comply with hazardous environment safety standards (e.g., ATEX/PESO certifications).
  • Technical Documentation: Prepare test reports, schematic designs, and system performance logs for cross-functional review.
minimumQualification:
Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Experience: 1 to 5 years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, embedded systems, or oil & gas instrumentation.
  • Hardware & Programming: Proficiency in working with microcontrollers and development boards (e.g., Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32) and associated motor drivers.
  • Communication Protocols: Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as CAN, Modbus, RS-485, and Ethernet.
  • Physical & Field Requirements: Must be comfortable working in industrial environments and supporting site inspections, which may require travel.
  • NDT Familiarity: Prior experience or willingness to learn NDT methodologies (e.g., Ultrasonic Testing) and industry codes is a strong plus).
preferredQualification:
Candidate Profile

  • Growth Mindset: Interested in long-term employment with a desire to move up within the company.
  • Work Ethic: Willing to work at any level and "get your hands dirty" to ensure project success.
  • Adaptability: Able to handle the pressure of live site environments and remote location.
